title: Monochromatic triangles with empty intersection and Kneser Ramsey numbers
summary: Recently, Heath, McCourt, Parker, Schwieder, and Zerbib initiated the systematic study of the $r$-Kneser Ramsey number $R_r^{KG}(s,t)$ and investigated related Ramsey-type problems. A central motivation for their work comes from a question of Holmsen, Hrusak, and Roldán-Pensado, who asked whether, for $n=2k-1$ and sufficiently large $k$, every red/blue edge-coloring of the complete graph on the vertex set $V = \binom{[n]}{k}$ necessarily contains a monochromatic triangle $ABC$ with $A,B,C \in V$ and $A \cap B \cap C = \emptyset$.
